 for path in paths:

  data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',spec])

  target.write_bytes(data)

The checked-in build setting is fixed False and not request/env/external configuration.
Existing entry point: routes.get(path); dependency settings.current_settings(); config.EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED; newly added preview.render_preview(). Tests: tests/test_routes.py. Read actual sources to evaluate behavior.
## Task Scope
Review mode: mid-implementation.
In scope: Task 1, Prepare preview module — status in-progress, explicitly selected by user.
Out of scope: Task 2, Implement and enable export preview — status pending, depends on Task 1; implement render_preview and enabled-path tests before changing build setting.
Do not report pending Task 2 implementation as missing. Pending tasks do not excuse current regressions or compatibility failures. Assess actual startup/import, settings response, unknown route, and disabled preview route behavior under the documented fixed setting.
Baselines: HEAD is review base and source-compatibility baseline only. No separate released/deployed revision is named; README states no deployment inventory exists. No production/deployment claim is requested.
Evidence: actual complete index source and full HEAD source for route/config/settings/tests, all with provenance in manifest.json. No tests had been run by parent at evidence assembly; independently distinguish source inspection from execution. No author test claims supplied.
Knowledge: parent searches of kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms returned an empty knowledge base.
Rejected approaches: none supplied.
PAL tools/listmodels not available in tool catalog; external reviewer unavailable. Independent reviewer must not imply corroboration.
''')
manifest={'instructions':[str(x) for x in common+checklists],'active_profiles':[{'profile':'python','checklist':str(x),'triggered_by':'content signal: .py extension; preview.py and routes.py'} for x in checklists],'diff':str(patch),'context':str(context),'candidate_sources':[r['source_path'] for r in records if 'staged index' in r['revision']],'historical_sources':[r['source_path'] for r in records if r['revision']==base],'provenance':records,'missing_evidence':'No source required by documented Task 1 known missing.
